title: Oliver Giles and Kid Bush's band
summary: Oliver played in different city bands, with Kid Bush among those named.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Remembering King Oliver: the man, the band, the decline

blocks.x: Who did Oliver Jones or Olivier, I want to know about that?

Who did he play with? Well he played with different bands in the city, he played here in the Orleans. A fellow they called Bush, Kid Bush, I don't know if you ever heard of him. You see a long time ago that's the way they used to call bands.
Kid Horry, Kid Rene, Kid Punch you know?
What did Bush play? He played trumpet.
Lawrence told me he worked with a guy called Bush Hall. That's the same one.
Lawrence Morero. That's right. That's right. That's been a pretty good band. Oh yeah. Crackley at that time, most of the bands were good.
